name: @fl03/harness-codex
description: Codex CLI adapter: materializes @fl03/compiler's `codex` emission target (skills/, shepherd.codex.toml -- no command surface, Codex has nowhere to put one) onto this package's own root, maps the 8 shepherd roles onto Codex's two native primitives (explorer read-only, worker write-capable) via [agent_types], declares the max_concurrent_children = 3 descendant cap plus per-role [models]/[profiles.*] reasoning_effort pins, and wires a PreToolUse guard (hooks/hooks.json + hooks/scripts/shepherd_guard.mjs) interpreting content/predicates/*.toml for write-boundary and git-custody. Implemented in Wave 4 (W4-S5).
